text_sections: 12 Days: ArgoCon and KeycloakCon are Almost Here! Don’t Miss Your Chance to Join Us July 28 in Yokohama

The countdown is on! ArgoCon and KeycloakCon land in Yokohama in just 12 days These CNCF-hosted co-located events kick off KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Japan with a full day of technical talks: KeycloakCon takes the morning, ArgoCon takes the afternoon, and a shared evening reception brings everyone together. Add one (or both!) to your registration before time runs out.
Start Your Morning at KeycloakCon

Grab your coffee and settle in! KeycloakCon's half-day, single-track program puts you in the room with Keycloak developers, maintainers, and power users. This year's talks dig into securing applications and cloud native infrastructure, identity for AI agents, the newest Keycloak features, and lessons from real-world deployments.
